## capabilityDomain: architecture-boundary

### [LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1] 玄学单线架构与公共边界

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "scripts/**",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "architecture-boundary",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-002-V1"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "static",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：除 xuanxue-ai-production 外的第二 active business plugin 或旧业务 source root 进入生产主链。",
    "不得发生：Mediator 执行业务步骤、浏览器动作或能力私有实现。",
    "不得发生：Plugin 绕过 public capability facade 导入 child runtime、私有协议或基础设施实现。",
    "不得发生：Capability 导入 Plugin、隐藏业务 workflow 或跨能力读取私有 runtime。",
    "不得发生：src/lib、src/types、scripts/startup、scripts/acceptance 或 scripts/audit 越权承担业务编排。",
    "不得发生：public facade 泄漏私有实现类型、浏览器内部协议、selector、coordinate 或 provider 私有对象。",
    "不得发生：旧 source root、第二 mediator、兼容桥、平行入口或无期限 adapter 保持可达。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须保持玄学需求经唯一 Mediator、xuanxue Plugin、公共 Capability facade、Child Ability、Evidence/Log/Result 的单线架构，并使每个 source root 只有一个职责和一个 Owner。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: capability-governance

### [LAW-CAPABILITY-GOVERNANCE-001-V1] 能力原子性与 Facade

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "src/capabilities/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "capability-governance",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：能力组同时承担不同种类动作、业务决策、步骤顺序或终态裁决。",
    "不得发生：Child Ability 隐藏多步 workflow、跨 Owner 调用或直接返回业务最终结果。",
    "不得发生：消费者绕过唯一 public facade 导入非 facade 文件或 private runtime。",
    "不得发生：Capability 使用 shared/common/utils/service/manager/facade/bridge/adapter 名称隐藏无 Owner 逻辑。",
    "不得发生：没有真实玄学生产 consumer 的能力、export、registry entry 或动态入口被当作在用。",
    "不得发生：能力 inventory 恢复 Amazon、video、media 或其它非玄学历史业务。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-CAPABILITY-GOVERNANCE-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使每个 Capability 只提供同类、原子、类型明确的动作，经唯一公共 Facade 暴露，并以玄学生产调用图证明每个能力和导出真实在用。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: code-purity

### [LAW-CODE-PURITY-001-V1] 代码纯洁度与僵尸零容忍

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "scripts/**",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "code-purity",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-AUDIT-SYSTEM-001-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-002-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-005-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-006-V1"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.dependency",
    "static.config",
    "static.json",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [
    "scripts/acceptance/fixtures/**",
    "scripts/audit/generated/**",
    "src/plugins/xuanxue-ai-production/generated/**"
  ],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：活动源码文件超过 500 个物理行，或函数超过 75 行、7 个参数、8 个返回分支、5 层嵌套、16 圈复杂度或10个 await。",
    "不得发生：God file、God function、混合 Owner、混合运行角色、无 Owner 文件或以 utils/helpers/common/shared/service/manager/facade/bridge/adapter 隐藏职责。",
    "不得发生：zombie 文件、zombie 导出、孤立顶层声明、死导出 helper 链、死内部声明岛、字面量或常量折叠后的死分支。",
    "不得发生：未证明最终消费者的 re-export、namespace、registry、object bag、handler map 或 zombie-to-zombie 链被当作活性证据。",
    "不得发生：动态 import 非字面量、未解析、未由 Owner 明示，或副作用 import 充当隐藏 keepalive。",
    "不得发生：import、re-export、dynamic import 或 side-effect import 以不同语法绕过同一 Owner 边界。",
    "不得发生：能力域导入 plugin、plugin 导入能力私有 runtime、mediator 执行浏览器动作或 child ability 隐藏多步业务流。",
    "不得发生：any、ts-ignore、ts-nocheck、catch-and-swallow、伪成功、mock/demo/placeholder/no-op/fallback 生产路径或固定 PASS。",
    "不得发生：export star、无合法工具要求的 default export、require、超过 28 个 import declaration、24 个 import source 或24个命名导出。",
    "不得发生：兼容桥、legacy 双轨、shadow truth、永久 adapter 或未具备 Owner、监控、期限和删除验收的迁移机制。",
    "不得发生：generated artifact 被手工维护为源真相，或注释掉的可执行代码代替物理删除。",
    "不得发生：代码纯洁度检查使用正则、标识符计数、文件命名或 source-text 搜索冒充 AST、symbol graph 和模块图执法。",
    "不得发生：触碰已越过红线的文件后继续加逻辑、降低阈值、增加豁免或跳过检查让 CI 变绿。",
    "不得发生：Code Purity finding 不进入唯一质量报告、不改变二元 verdict 或被降级为 warning。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-CODE-PURITY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使每个活动源码文件证明唯一 Owner、单一角色和真实活性，并以 AST、类型、symbol graph、模块图及反规避检查对结构红线、Owner 边界、类型逃逸、伪运行、兼容双轨和全部 zombie surface 实行零容忍二元执法。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```
## capabilityDomain: audit-system

### [LAW-AUDIT-SYSTEM-001-V1] 质检系统主权与真实执法

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "**/*"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "audit-system",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-001-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-002-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-004-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-006-V1",
    "LAW-PROJECT-GOVERNANCE-007-V1"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.filesystem",
    "static.ast",
    "static.contract",
    "static.dependency",
    "static.config",
    "static.json",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：质检入口绕过唯一 active law、Manifest、registry、检查回执或逐 lawId 报告。",
    "不得发生：第二 quality 命令、第二 verdict、平行 runner、手工 law mapping 或手工 generated truth。",
    "不得发生：能力域缺失唯一 Manifest、唯一检查路由、唯一 Owner，或一个检查越权替多个域裁决。",
    "不得发生：runner、测试、报告或 generated artifact 反向取得法案主权。",
    "不得发生：仅凭退出码、文件存在、历史结果、fixture、mock、warning 或自然语言制造 PASS。",
    "不得发生：Static、Exam、Dynamic 证据互相冒充，或适用证据未执行仍生成 PASS。",
    "不得发生：质检器使用源文本关键词、正则命中、固定值或自报声明冒充 AST、symbol、依赖或运行证据。",
    "不得发生：owner 检查未真实执行、finding 未改变 verdict、FAIL 被吞掉或降级为 warning。",
    "不得发生：候选、法案、registry、证据或执法表面漂移后继续复用旧结论。",
    "不得发生：质检系统删除、跳过或不路由 code-purity 现役检查。",
    "不得发生：为恢复旧系统重新建立与冻结说明书冲突的多份 matrix、plan、conflict 或报告真相。",
    "不得发生：审计系统不能检查自身唯一入口、路由完整性、报告分母和负向失败能力。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-AUDIT-SYSTEM-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使质检系统保持从两份 active law、唯一 Manifest/Owner、唯一 registry、真实检查回执到逐 lawId 二元报告的单一可复放执法链，并以自检和故障注入证明任何违法都会失败关闭。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

## capabilityDomain: system-security

### [LAW-SYSTEM-SECURITY-001-V1] 玄学生产安全与隐私

```law-record
{
  "appliesTo": [
    "scripts/**",
    "src/**"
  ],
  "capabilityDomain": "system-security",
  "dependsOnLawIds": [
    "LAW-ARCHITECTURE-BOUNDARY-001-V1",
    "LAW-RUNTIME-LOG-SPINE-001-V3"
  ],
  "enforcementMode": "composite",
  "evidenceModes": [
    "static.ast",
    "static.types",
    "static.contract",
    "static.dependency",
    "static.config",
    "exam.golden"
  ],
  "excludes": [],
  "forbidden": [
    "不得发生：secret、token、cookie、authorization、browser identity、用户输入或附件内容进入日志、错误文本或持久化明文。",
    "不得发生：未验证 JSON、外部响应、Cloud order、AI response 或浏览器消息直接取得内部类型身份。",
    "不得发生：网站下发 nextAction、selector、coordinate、Target、Document 或 Browser command 遥控 AGENT。",
    "不得发生：Extension 访问 Cloud、Provider 凭证越过 Owner，或本地 UI 成为第二业务入口。",
    "不得发生：AI 决定不可逆最终动作、安全裁决、授权裁决或伪造成功。",
    "不得发生：失败分支泄漏敏感数据、吞掉鉴权错误、降级到不安全 fallback 或重放 UNKNOWN 动作。"
  ],
  "lawId": "LAW-SYSTEM-SECURITY-001-V1",
  "schemaVersion": 2,
  "status": "active",
  "summary": "必须使玄学生产中的凭证、浏览器身份、用户输入、AI 传输、Cloud Pull 和最终动作保持最小权限、结构验证、敏感信息脱敏与失败关闭。",
  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

```law-record
  "summary": "必须保持以下不变量：Structured logging is subordinate to the single Runtime Log Spine and must preserve FLOW, DEBUG, TRACE structure and sink-before-output redaction without a second logging authority.",
  "supersedesLawId": "LAW-RUNTIME-LOG-SPINE-003-V1",
  "tier": "P0"
}
```

```law-record
    "不得发生：CI、audit、typecheck、acceptance、Browser build/verify/real-chrome 作为普通启动步骤。",

  "supersedesLawId": null,
  "tier": "P0"
}
```
